title: Jaro Winkler Similarity
description: Compares first and second strings and returns Jaro and Jaro–Winkler similarities (0–1, higher means more similar), rounded to 12 decimal places, plus matching prefix length (capped at 4) and preprocessed string lengths. Uses UTF-16 code units, not Unicode code points or graphemes. Optional ignoreCase (default false) uses Unicode lowercase, not full case folding. Whitespace is significant; no normalization is applied. Matches Natural's unconditional prefix bonus with scale 0.1, including scores below 0.7. Identical preprocessed strings, including two empty strings, score 1; one empty string scores 0. Inputs limited to 4096 UTF-16 units each. Invalid input returns valid:false, error and message.
